reason: Finish review found the unverified state (`none`) reused the busy spinner icon, so an unverified listing looked like it was still loading. The rule is class-level for every badge state, so future state or icon edits land here.

The user approved replacing the colour emoji in the badge report line and asked for the same change on the /viewing "All good" option. The old rule said to ask first and called the emoji the only one in the product; that is now superseded.
The extension note was ruled a caution and styled from the existing warn tokens rather than a new colour. The next badge edit needs that ruling, or it will reach for the red alert or invent a colour.

The final review found the retired amber state still present in four places: a dead CSS rule, DESIGN.md lines, a test that accepted it, and an unused import. A removal checklist prevents that next time.
